selectionGuide.description: Two stacked reaction panels show the same man moving from pleased anticipation to visible disappointment.
bestFor: expectation-versus-reality contrasts with a clear emotional reversal
hypocrisy where a stated standard conflicts with actual behavior
a promising claim followed by a disappointing result
avoidWhen: the joke has no meaningful two-part contrast
three or more independently labeled actors are required
the punchline is a single opinion rather than a reversal

mechanics.visual: The top reaction reads as approval or hope; the bottom reaction turns that same setup into disappointment.
mechanics.text: Put the promise, expectation, or public claim in expectation and its contradictory outcome in reality; parallel phrasing works best.
